primitives.name: Moneyline Settlement Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest"; import { calculatePickResult } from "../settlement.js"; const NFL
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{ml}': 'Boolean outcome (WIN, LOSS, PUSH)', 'Winner': "Actual winning team (or 'Draw' for soccer)", 'BettedTeam': "User's selected team"}
primitives.assumptions: Deterministic winner exists; draws treated as PUSH in soccer markets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Binary win/loss for non-soccer; ternary outcome for soccer with PUSH condition.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI posterior predictive distribution over outcomes. Translates to GSE decision node 'check_winner'.
layer2.telemetry: Historical win rate P(Winner | BettedTeam) for binary markets; draw probability P(Draw) for soccer.

primitives.name: Total Settlement Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest"; import { calculatePickResult } from "../settlement.js"; const NFL
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{total}': 'Boolean outcome (OVER, UNDER, PUSH)', 'Total': 'Combined final score (Goals or Points)', 'Line': 'Over/Under threshold (Points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Fixed total score sum; no halftime adjustments applied retroactively.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Step function across exact threshold crossing.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction interval coverage test. Maps to GSE resource allocation as 'total_check' transition.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical tail probabilities P(Total > Line) from historical league distributions.
